name: P1-ecology-review-after-fixes
description: Follow-up to P1-ecology-review, run after seeing its results (not preregistered): seeds 1-4 of both landscape types, which include the worst fire years and the deer collapses, after the three corrections of T-006 (no herbaceous litter on ground burned that year; starting numbers per km2 of habitat; hungry grazers search 3 km). Judged against the same preregistered criteria.
